name: reboot-residue R-001 live (rubric rev15 wording): agenticmail.service stable, API entry under the exec'd node's global root, health route /api/agenticmail/health 200
summary: Re-run of the R-001 live probe after AUTO-BAR-R-001-P-001 was amended (rubric revision 15, approved by outside-lineage reviewer su-c044d7ba in thread-post:1159579) to name the route the AgenticMail API actually serves. agenticmail.service active/running, MainPID 3758554 and NRestarts 0 unchanged across a 60s window; the unit's exec line names the @agenticmail/api dist under `npm root -g` of the node it runs; GET http://127.0.0.1:3150/api/agenticmail/health (host:port from ~/.agenticmail/config.json) -> HTTP 200 {status:ok, version:0.5.62, services:{api:ok, stalwart:ok}}.
scope: Live host plane, read-only observation; nothing reinstalled or restarted. GET /api/health on the same host:port still returns 404 and is recorded as a disclosure: the server mounts its health router only under /api/agenticmail. The health body's version 0.5.62 is the @agenticmail/api package version; the top-level agenticmail package is 0.5.54 (both read from the installed package.json files), which answers the grader's open version question in EI-25223052791034587.
oracle: Independent of the repair: systemd unit properties, the unit's own exec script, the exec'd node's npm root -g, /proc/<MainPID>/cmdline and an HTTP GET against the configured API host:port.
redaction: The operator's home directory is rendered as ~ in the retained log (one unit_execstart line was redacted by hand at 10:31Z after git-sync quarantined the raw capture for an identity leak; no other byte changed).

assertions.evidence: ActiveState=active SubState=running, MainPID 3758554 and NRestarts 0 at T0 and T1 (60s apart).

start-server.sh exec line names /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/lib/node_modules/agenticmail/node_modules/@agenticmail/api/dist/index.js, which exists and lies under `npm root -g` (/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/lib/node_modules) of /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/node.
Disclosure, not a failure: GET /api/health returns 404 because the server never mounts that path.
